testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > EDG-003: Signed-out user opening /checkout or /cart is sent to login

scenario.summary: A signed-out user in a fresh browser context who opens /checkout or /cart directly is redirected to the login page and sees no Place Your Order page, sections or cart content.
steps: Start a fresh browser context without signing in
Open /checkout on the storefront (config webstoreURL) and observe the page
assertions: Both URLs redirect to the login page
The Place Your Order page, its sections and any cart content are not shown
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases EDG-003 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)
